flex-global-kyrgyzstan-2028-29.about:
FLEX Global is the U.S. Department of State's merit-based high-school exchange that merges the Future Leaders Exchange (FLEX, 30+ years) and the Kennedy-Lugar Youth Exchange and Study (YES). It is implemented by American Councils for International Education with AFS, Amideast and iEARN, and Kyrgyzstan is one of its 31 countries. Finalists spend a full year with a screened volunteer host family, attend a U.S. high school, do community service and take part in 'American Excellence' activities on business, technology and entrepreneurship.

The 2027-28 round for Kyrgyzstan closed on 2026-10-22 (eligible then: grades 9 or 10, born 1 Jan 2010 - 31 Dec 2011). FLEX has recruited every autumn for decades, so the 2028-29 round is expected to open around August-September 2027 with an October deadline and a birth window roughly one year later; the national office (https://kyrgyzstan.americancouncils.org/) publishes the exact dates. Selection is free: English test, proctored essays, interview and a full application, with final selection in the U.S.

Use the year to prepare: keep grades high, practise English and short essays, and be ready to explain why you would be a good cultural ambassador. Finalists learn their status in spring and fly to the U.S. in August.
highlights: Full school year in the U.S. with a host family, fully funded

flex-global-kyrgyzstan-2028-29.eligibility: Citizens of Kyrgyzstan enrolled in secondary school in Kyrgyzstan: grades 9 or 10, birth window for 2028-29 not yet published (2027-28 window was 1 Jan 2010 - 31 Dec 2011; expect it to move by about a year). Good academic standing, previous English study, U.S. J-1 visa eligibility and an international passport. Not eligible: students whose family has applied or plans to emigrate to the U.S.; usually not those who will have graduated before departure.
how_to_apply: Follow the Kyrgyzstan FLEX Global office (https://kyrgyzstan.americancouncils.org/) and the FLEX Global Instagram for the 2028-29 announcement (around September 2027)
Check the new birth-date and grade window in the brochure when it is published
Register on ais.americancouncils.org/flexglobal and take the English test
Write the proctored essays and attend the interview if you advance
Submit the full application; finalists are announced in spring
flex-global-kyrgyzstan-2028-29.costs: Free to apply. Covered: round-trip international and domestic travel, monthly allowance, host-family placement, U.S. school enrolment, orientations, local programme activities and medical insurance (excluding pre-existing conditions and dental). Not covered: passport costs, personal expenses beyond the stipend, excess baggage, internet/data plans.
